title: Grateful Dead Live at Kresge Plaza, M.I.T. on 1970-05-06
lineage: 2022 reseed: SBE repaired in track 04, SHN files re-encoded to FLAC-8: SHN>WAV>FLAC-8
source: MSR (MIT Reels) > Sonic Solutions Digital Editing (gans) > DATs > CDRs > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Energetic 1970 post‑Fillmore show captured on an enthusiastic audience recording that highlights Jerry's thunderous and nuanced guitar work.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the raw, loose vibe of these two shows right after the Fillmore run, calling the sound “amazing” and noting how Jerry Garcia both thunders and plays softly. The audio is an audience copy, but it’s described as clear enough to enjoy the performance, making it a solid listen for true Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 4‑star review emphasizes both strong musical performance and surprisingly good audience recording quality, leading to a high overall rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape praised for its clarity and excitement; no specific flaws mentioned, but being an audience copy suggests typical ambient noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a loose, cutting‑loose performance right after the Fillmore run, delivering high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highlighted for both thunderous and soft playing, showcasing his dynamic range.
